description:
Dematic is seeking an innovative and collaborative AI Solutions Analyst to join our growing artificial intelligence program. This full-time role provides an opportunity to work alongside business and technology professionals to identify, develop, and implement AI solutions that improve how we operate and deliver value to our customers.

You will support initiatives involving Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, data, and emerging technologies, helping translate business opportunities into practical AI-enabled solutions.

The ideal candidate is curious, analytical, comfortable working across technical and business teams, and excited about applying AI to real-world challenges. This position is well suited for an early-career professional looking to build deep experience in enterprise AI while contributing to high-impact initiatives from day one. 
 We offer: 
 
 What We Offer: 

 Career Development 
 Competitive Compensation and Benefits 
 Pay Transparency 
 Global Opportunities  
 
 Learn More Here: https://www.dematic.com/en-us/about/careers/what-we-offer 

 Dematic provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.  

 This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. 

 The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $80,000 - $100,000 at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.  
 
 Tasks and Qualifications: 
 What You Will Do
 Collaborate with business and technology partners to identify opportunities where AI can improve processes, productivity, decision-making, and customer outcomes.
 Support the design, development, testing, and implementation of Generative AI and Agentic AI use cases.
 Conduct research and analysis on emerging AI technologies, tools, and potential business applications.
 Gather and document business requirements and translate them into actionable technical or project requirements.
 Assist with data collection, preparation, validation, and analysis needed to support AI initiatives.
 Participate in AI pilots, proofs of concept, testing, and implementation activities.
 Analyze results and recommend improvements based on performance, user feedback, and business impact.
 Develop documentation, presentations, dashboards, and communications that help explain AI solutions and project outcomes.
 Work with cross-functional stakeholders across engineering, IT, data, project management, and business functions.
 Contribute to responsible AI practices, including appropriate testing, documentation, governance, and risk awareness.
 Stay current on emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply new capabilities within Dematic.
 
 What We’re Looking For
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, Business, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
 Experience or academic/project exposure involving artificial intelligence, Generative AI, machine learning, data analytics, automation, or related technologies.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break complex problems into actionable steps.
 Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them to real business challenges.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within cross-functional teams.
 A self-starter mindset with curiosity, initiative, and a commitment to continuous learning.
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Hands-on experience with Generative AI tools, large language models, AI agents, or AI-enabled automation.
 Familiarity with platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Azure, Azure AI, Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Python, SQL, APIs, or data visualization tools.
 Experience developing prototypes, proofs of concept, or AI-enabled applications.
 Understanding of data analysis, data engineering, software development, business analysis, or project management methodologies.
 Experience working with cross-functional business and technology teams.
 Familiarity with responsible AI, data privacy, security, and AI governance concepts.
 
 What Success Looks Like
 In this role, you will help move AI opportunities from ideas to practical business solutions. Success means understanding business challenges, collaborating with the right stakeholders, helping develop and test solutions, and demonstrating measurable value through improved efficiency, automation, insights, or user experiences.


 Why Join Dematic?
 Dematic is a global leader in intelligent automation, combining engineering, software, data, and technology to solve complex supply chain challenges.
 This role offers the opportunity to build your career at the intersection of AI, technology, engineering, and business transformation, while contributing to solutions with real operational impact.
 If you are curious about how AI can transform the way organizations work and want the opportunity to help build that future, we encourage you to apply.
